thread:
alex_w: Heads-up: seeing noisy GPU flares in us-west over the last 6h. Current rule pages on any node OOM spike >1 for 2m — that's way too chatty for the SRE rota. Can we rework page vs ticket thresholds and grouping?

maria_g: Agree. Most of these are 30–90s transient flares. We should avoid paging for single-node blips. Suggest hysteresis + sustained window before paging.

jonathan_k: Proposal: create two alerts and different backends. Example: GPU_Flare_Warning -> ticket (ops queue) when >5% GPUs affected for 5m. GPU_Flare_Critical -> page (oncall) when >20% GPUs affected for 3m or if cluster-level eviction rate spikes.

kevin_r: FWIW, we can also use Alertmanager grouping and `severity` label to route. Group by `region, pool` and use `fingerprint` for dedupe.

alex_w: Good. Also want a short mute/hysteresis so we don't get repeated pages from the same noisy host — maybe 30m repeat mute after ack for duplicate fingerprints.

ops-bot: Alertmanager: silence created by <@alex_w> for label_match {region="us-west"} expires in 14d — reason: alert tuning canary.

maria_g: I'll add a recording rule for `gpu_flare_rate` so panels can show 1m/5m windows and a baseline. Will create a Grafana panel & an SLO check tied to it.

kevin_r: Example Prometheus rule snippet to use as starting point:

```yaml
- alert: GPU_Flare_Warning
  expr: (sum by(cluster)(irate(gpu_flare_total[5m])) / sum by(cluster)(gpu_total)) * 100 > 5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    tier: infra
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-flares

- alert: GPU_Flare_Critical
  expr: (sum by(cluster)(irate(gpu_flare_total[3m])) / sum by(cluster)(gpu_total)) * 100 > 20
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: critical
    tier: infra
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-flares#critical
```

jonathan_k: We should also add a short-term recording rule that smooths spikes: `gpu_flare_rate:avg5m` so paging doesn't fire on single-sample noise.

tanya_s: SGTM. For Alertmanager config: group_by: ['region','pool'] and use `group_interval: 1m`, `repeat_interval: 30m` — plus route critical -> pager, warning -> ticket webhook.

alex_w: Let's trial these changes in us-west canary, and mirror to us-east after 48h of no regressions. Trial window: 2 weeks. I'll open an RFC and patch Alertmanager rules as a canary change. Volunteers to monitor?

maria_g: :thumbsup: I'll stand up the Grafana panels and add an alerting dashboard to the runbook.

jonathan_k: I'll own the Prometheus rule changes and deploy to canary. Will add a recording rule and a noise-suppression expr.

tanya_s: I'll update the runbook with paging decision tree and add the Zendesk ticket hook for warnings.

alex_w: Action items: alex -> RFC + canary silence (link: https://redwood.internal/rfc/1234), jonathan -> PR for prometheus rules, maria -> dashboard & SLO panel, tanya -> runbook + ticket hook. We'll re-evaluate and roll forward or revert after 2 weeks. :rotating_light:

kevin_r: One more ask: add logs link in annotations like `{{ $labels.instance }} -> https://logs.redwood.internal/q?host={{ $labels.instance }}` so oncall can jump to relevant logs quickly.

alex_w: Good call. I'll include that in the annotations. Thanks all — let's keep the canary small and watch the Grafana panels in the #eng-sre channel.
